title: Megurine Luka — An Idol's Knowledge〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hello!
Thanks for having me again today!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Welcome, Minori♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But are you sure you don't need a break?
You just finished putting on a show too so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, but I'm okay. I feel like my body can really keep up now, so I want to practice!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, I'm the one that asked you to help me practice!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But only as long as I'm not being a bother to you, Luka...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
No, I don't feel that way at all.
As long as you're okay with it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Anyways, shall we get started♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Luka, thanks again for today!
See you again!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Another job well done, Professor Luka!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. We even got to do the fishy box step again.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes♪ Minori has learned how to smoothly switch between different dances quite well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And it's all thanks to her incredible work ethic♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! She's really been giving it everything she has!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree. Luka, you've been a great teacher as well♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I have?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She's learned to relax and have confidence in herself thanks to you. It's done wonders for her.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Totally! It's so cool how she can really speed up, hop, step, jump and stop in a snap now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It looks like your fishy exercises are really doing the trick for her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, maybe just a little.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But she was the one that was determined to practice every day to make their show a success.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She was that driven and her passion made it all a reality.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Her passion, huh?
Yes, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And I'm looking forward to seeing more♪
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Welcome, Minori♪
I'm looking forward to another good session!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! Oh, would it be okay if we did something else first? About those fishy dances we've been doing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I just wanted to say that those drills really helped me understand how to jump between different rhythms!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka even said that my dancing's improved a lot and that it looks much sharper than before!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's great!
I'm so happy for you♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe. Also, I'm really starting to understand that I need to stay loose and relaxed while I dance!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In that case, let's start with a quick pop quiz♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: When do you think you should be more relaxed?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Easy! I found the answer to that in a ASRUN DVD of one of their tours!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: First, when you move to the back as others move to the front of the stage!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In this case, everyone in the back danced a little more discretely to let everyone in the front stand out more!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, very good♪
And?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! During long instrumental parts as well! Instead of dancing in place, everyone tried to make eye contact with the audience!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What else...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That's wonderful, Minori!
You've made quite a few discoveries♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Teehee...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was really focused on trying my best or doing everything I can, but I'm understanding how important it is to stay loose now too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's really incredible just how much of a difference it makes, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. I'm glad that I could help, Minori♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But this rabbit hole goes much deeper than that, you know.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right. I got a sense of that too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Each time watched that DVD, I kept finding new things that I never even thought to look for.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It just means that you're learning to see things from an idol's point of view, no?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You even found some fans that truly believe in you thanks to your videos, right? Fans you want to give hope.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As you keep learning about who you're trying to give hope to, I'm sure your understanding will keep evolving along with it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That makes so much sense!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Minori's taken quite a big step forward as an idol...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (It may be only a matter of time until the hard-working Minori that we first met blooms into a beautiful idol.)
